C4_admin_to_caisse.question: Owner pousse promo flash → caisse l'applique automatique ?
C4_admin_to_caisse.verdict: PARTIAL_NO — server-side broadcast exists, but the POS frontend does not consume it and the POS has no UI to apply any promo code.
screens_audited: resources/js/components/admin/pos/PosComponent.vue lines 2660-2720 (_subscribeEcho — three broadcastAs entries: OrderCreated, OrderStatusChanged, OrderPaidAtCounter; also ItemAvailabilityChanged + CatalogChanged at 2714-2715)

findings.headline: POS frontend does NOT subscribe to CouponChanged broadcasts — only the Kiosk does.
findings.evidence: Grep across resources/js/components/admin/pos/ returns ZERO matches for 'CouponChanged'. The only frontend consumer is resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskAppComponent.vue:571 ('broadcastAs: CouponChanged' + handler _handleCouponChanged at line 780). PosComponent.vue _subscribeEcho registers five bindings (OrderCreated, OrderStatusChanged, OrderPaidAtCounter, ItemAvailabilityChanged, CatalogChanged) — no CouponChanged.
findings.consequence: If admin creates / toggles a coupon while a POS session is active, the cashier UI never reacts. No staleness toast, no menu/discount refresh, no real-time invalidation. The POS application has no 'auto-apply promo flash' code path at all.

findings.headline: POS has NO UI to enter or auto-apply a promo code.
findings.evidence: resources/js/components/admin/pos/PosComponent.vue contains the field 'coupon_id: null' twice (line 1567 in order template, line 3258 in reset) but no input, no axios call to /frontend/coupon-checking, no use of /api/frontend/promo/validate. The only coupon UI is resources/js/components/frontend/checkout/CouponComponent.vue (delivery checkout) — distinct surface, not POS. Kiosk consumes promos at /api/frontend/promo/validate (KioskPromoService); POS does not.
findings.consequence: Even if a real-time CouponChanged broadcast reached PosComponent, there would be no field/state to update. 'Promo flash auto-apply on caisse' is unimplemented end-to-end. Owner-side dashboard CRUD reaches Kiosk only.

findings.headline: No 'flash promo' (push-now, time-boxed alert) concept distinct from standard valid_from/valid_to.
findings.evidence: Grep for 'flash_promo|FlashPromo|happy_hour|promo_alert|flash' across app/, database/migrations/, routes/, app/Events/ returns zero domain-specific matches. KioskPromo has only valid_from/valid_to/active/max_uses; Coupon has start_date/end_date. CouponChanged change types are CREATED|UPDATED|DELETED|STATUS_TOGGLED — no 'flash' / 'broadcast_now' variant.
findings.consequence: What an owner would call 'flash promo' (e.g. 'instant 10% for next 30 min, push every terminal NOW') has no first-class model. The closest workflow is: admin creates Coupon or KioskPromo with valid_from=now and short valid_to, kiosk picks it up next REST validate or via cache invalidate triggered by CouponChanged → for KIOSK only.

C4_admin_to_caisse.top_gap: C4-F1: CouponChanged is broadcast on private-branch.{id} via the outbox (PersistCouponChangedToOutbox.php:73 channel='private-branch.<id>', broadcast_as='CouponChanged') but PosComponent.vue _subscribeEcho omits it entirely. Compounded by C4-F2: POS has no apply-promo UI, so even adding the listener is a no-op without scope expansion.

C5_stock_to_borne_pos_kds.question: Rupture cohérente partout (Borne + POS + KDS) ? ItemAvailabilityChanged propagation vérifié ? Latence ? POS vs Kiosk coherent ?
C5_stock_to_borne_pos_kds.verdict: PASS — propagation is implemented uniformly across all four surfaces with a single event contract, an outbox-backed broadcast, and a verified failure-isolation policy. Latency floor is bound by DispatchDomainEventsJob queue lane (sync in dev, async in prod) + Pusher round-trip, not by polling.
evidence_trail: Event source: app/Events/ItemAvailabilityChanged.php — two factories fromItem() (global) + forBranch() (branch-scoped MENU_86). Uses DispatchableAfterCommit trait.

Server emitters: app/Services/Stock/StockService.php:151,202,211 + app/Services/Menu/AvailabilityService.php:386,763 (DB::afterCommit closure → event(...)) + app/Services/ItemService.php:406,564 + app/Services/ItemExtraService.php:127 + app/Services/ItemAddonService.php:91 + app/Services/ItemVariationService.php:201. Stock decrement-on-order also runs via app/Listeners/DecrementItemAvailabilityOnOrder.php with WG-2 isolation try/catch.

Outbox listener: app/Listeners/PersistItemAvailabilityChangedToOutbox.php builds a UNIFORM payload {item_id, status, price, type, is_available, branch_id, reason}. F-04bis fix (line 19-24) guarantees is_available, branch_id, reason are always present (possibly null) so frontend handlers can rely on them. Idempotency key includes correlation_id so toggles true→false→true across legitimate distinct requests each get their own row; same-request listener re-fire is collapsed.

Channel routing: branch-scoped event → ['private-branch.<branchId>']; global event (admin item edit) → fan-out to all active branches (whereIn status [Status::ACTIVE, 1] — heal A3 for legacy seeded status=1 rows).

Cache invalidation: app/Listeners/InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnItemAvailabilityChanged.php + app/Listeners/BumpMenuSnapshotOnItemAvailabilityChanged.php run inside the same dispatch so REST fallbacks also see fresh data.
Frontend consumers (all four):

- Kiosk: resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskAppComponent.vue:548-552 (broadcastAs 'ItemAvailabilityChanged' → _handleItemAvailabilityChanged at line 662). Cart prune handled in store/modules/kioskCart.js:404 (pruneUnavailable).

PersistItemAvailabilityChangedToOutbox.php:104-117 absorbs inline dispatch failures with structured log (gate 'test-e2e-fix-E-001-round-2') so an HTTP request never bubbles 500 on a Pusher hiccup.

findings.headline: Uniform payload contract holds across all consumers (F-04bis verified).
findings.evidence: Both KioskAppComponent and PosComponent gate cart pruning on a strict three-state is_available signal (true/false vs undefined for global). findings.headline: Latency contract — empirical baseline from memory snapshot.
findings.evidence: BRAIN MEMORY.md records 'Q9-S1 cross-surface sync : 0-60s → ~1s mesuré empiriquement' (reports/test-e2e/wave-polish-final-2026-05-21). Pipeline: emit → DB::afterCommit → firstOrCreate domain_events row → DB commit → DispatchDomainEventsJob → broadcaster->broadcast(channels, broadcast_as, envelope) → Pusher/Soketi → Echo .listen(`.ItemAvailabilityChanged`) → handler. No polling fallback is engaged in the happy path — handler runs as Pusher delivers. Polling fallback exists for Echo auth failure (PosComponent silent catch at 2717-2719).

findings.headline: Failure isolation — WG-2 listener guards prevent a single broken downstream from killing the cascade.

Outbox listener absorbs inline broadcast failure (PersistItemAvailabilityChangedToOutbox.php:104-117). Net: a Pusher outage degrades to REST/poll fallback without an HTTP 5xx surfacing to the cashier or kiosk customer.

findings.headline: POS vs Kiosk parity — confirmed both for prune-on-unavailable and for global-vs-branch distinction.
findings.evidence: PosComponent.vue:2790-2799 mirrors KioskAppComponent — same is_available coercion, same cart-prune dispatch, same announce. The historical drift (Audit POS-GA-F-45 — kiosk had it, POS did not) was healed in commit [POS-9.1.10]; the present code paths are symmetric.

findings.headline: Same-cashier idempotent replay is NOT broken by the K2 heals — the V5.5 sister guard is explicitly preserved.
findings.evidence: PaymentService.php:292-298 — when collected_by_user_id == current Auth::id() and the row is already PAID, returns 200 no-op with $order->setRawAttributes($locked->getAttributes(), true). Documented as defense behind IdempotencyKeyMiddleware (PosCounterCollectRaceProtectionSentinelTest.php:30-33 references the preserved pattern). The typed 409 only fires for race-loser (different cashier) or unknown collector.

C6_multi_device_sync.top_gap: NO GAP — K2-HEAL-01 and K2-HEAL-02 are fully implemented at service + route + frontend + sentinel layers. Other-cashier Echo notification is wired via OrderStatusChanged + OrderPaidAtCounter on private-branch.<id>, consumed by PosComponent and PosOrdersTracker. The only design caveat — by intent — is that race-loser cashier B sees their own 409 toast; cashier A doesn't get an extra 'you won the race' broadcast, but A's UI receives OrderStatusChanged/OrderPaidAtCounter which already refreshes the Q10 panel.
